hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) ruff format "$f" && ruff check --fix "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/ijobs_scraper/*.py) if grep -qE '^\s*(import|from)\s+(fastapi|sqlalchemy|django|flask|requests)\b' "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"VIOLATION: Forbidden framework import detected. This package must have ZERO framework coupling. Remove the import immediately.\"}}"; fi;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) mypy --strict "$f";; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
